organization.name: KhulnaSoft
organization.summary: The engineering organization behind the KhulnaSoft Engineering Knowledge OS: a continuously updated developer portal, AI context platform, and control plane for engineering assets, context, and automation.

hierarchy.resource: See the resource registry for the full taxonomy.

experience.name: Experience plane
experience.summary: Portal, catalog views, dashboards, and consuming surfaces for humans and agents.

knowledge.name: Knowledge plane
knowledge.summary: Normalized metadata, knowledge graphs, vectors, search indexes, documentation, and engineering context.

control.name: Control plane
control.summary: Orchestration and governance: organizations, workspaces, projects, policies, registries, workflows, events, approvals.

intelligence.name: Intelligence plane
intelligence.summary: Analyzers, scores, insights, health/readiness, recommendations, and technical-debt signals.

runtime.name: Runtime plane
runtime.summary: GitHub apps, events, workers, actions, AI workflows, deployment automation, self-healing operations.

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure plane
infrastructure.summary: Integrations for GitHub, GitLab, Kubernetes, cloud, data stores, and observability systems.

marketplace.name: Go service template
marketplace.summary: Opinionated Go microservice with health checks, structured logging, and a khulnasoft.yaml contract.

marketplace.name: Context composition prompt pack
marketplace.summary: Prompts that compose layered context and selective retrieval for agent tasks.

prompts.body:
# Architecture Prompt

Describe the architecture of the target resource, including:
- major components
- boundaries
- important relationships
- deployment assumptions

# Review Prompt

Review the repository context and summarize:
- architecture risks
- dependency concerns
- security posture
- release readiness
